I'm working out the JSON output now: findings 1 through 5 each need one entry, and the reviewer decision, which isn't numbered, still has to line up with the Open, In Progress, and Completed statuses. I'm also wondering whether the fix entry should be included or whether the decision alone covers it.

I'm settling on ascending order as the default for each sortable field, since the PRD doesn't specify a direction. Due date may be optional, so I'll need an edge case for tasks without one. Next I'm working out which revised tasks each finding should carry, so the backend change isn't repeated across findings.
